test_moolib_rpc_async_and_sync: test the moolib Rpc class by making async and sync RPC calls between client and host
test_moolib_async_callback: test the moolib Rpc async_callback method to handle responses via a callback function
test_moolib_nonexistent_function: test that calling a non-existent RPC function raises a RuntimeError with the correct message
test_moolib_dead_host: test that calling a dead host RPC endpoint raises a timeout RuntimeError
test_moolib_bidirectional_rpc: test bidirectional RPC calls where both client and host define and invoke each other functions
